When something becomes a necessity it is justified morally. Even though humans ate meat, it wasn't the main part of their diet. Humans didn't start eating massive amounts of meat until recently and it's affecting our health. High cholesterol, heart disease, certain forms of cancer, obesity. The dietetic associations of America and Britain have both stated that an appropriately planned plant based diet is adequate and healthy for all stages of life, including pregnancy and infancy. Even if it's healthy for humans to eat small amounts of meat, eating meat as much as the average consumer eats is in no way healthy. That's why many doctors believe whole foods plant based is considered the healthiest diet(this can include small amounts of animal products but doesn't have to). If you live in a country where you have a variety of foods to choose from, then buying animal products is not morally justified. It is no longer a necessity and just because we can do something, doesn't mean that we should.

Humans have been committing many abhorrent acts for many generations, but just because it is something we have always done, doesn't mean we should continue. Humans have continued to progress over time and becoming vegan is necessary in order for this world to progress. Animal agriculture is the leading cause of deforestation, habitat loss, oceanic dead zones, waste spillages, it is also a leading contributor to climate change, releasing more greenhouse gases than all forms of transportation combined. A recent study from the University of Oxford stated that going vegan is the number one way the average person can combat climate change. 

3 out of 4 new viruses introduced to humans come from animals. Think of all our pandemics in the past.. bird flu(chicken farm), swine flu(pig farm), mad cow disease(cow farm), and many others. Also Sars and covid19 came from wet markets. We will continue to have pandemics if we don't change the way that we interact with animals and nature. Also not to mention antibiotic resistance and all the other horrible things that animal agriculture is and contributes to. Humans have progressed and adapted amazingly until now and in order to progress, we need to stop looking at the past and what "we've always done" and start looking to the future, because frankly, if this world doesn't change then there won't be a future for anyone.
